fact: On 15 September 2026 the Prime Minister launched FasoSign, the national electronic signature platform, already operational on three government systems (SIGED, CIMEXT and SYC@D), with keys and certificates hosted in the country.
title: Burkina Faso/modernisation de l'administration publique : le Premier ministre lance la plateforme FasoSign pour « boucler la boucle » de la dématérialisation
